werkbank.text: Instead of the built-in recognition, this package can suggest fields from documents. It receives the document’s text and the description of the fields (without password fields and fields the user may not edit); Ablago checks every answer and shows it only as a suggestion.
werkbank.standard: Use this package as the default for all folder types
werkbank.standard.hilfe: Without the tick, the built-in recognition stays the default. You can override the choice on the folder type.
werkbank.laeuft-nicht: The package isn’t running right now – until it is, the built-in recognition takes over.
klassifizieren.netz: On the page “Take over document”, this package also suggests the folder type – only if it is chosen above as the standard for “Fill in from document”. It then gets the start of the document and the name, short description and “How to recognise it” of the folder types that are allowed for AI services – no folders.
klassifizieren.lokal: On the page “Take over document”, this package suggests the folder type, without network access. All it learns is which folder types similar documents are in (only those the person and the package may read, from folder types allowed for AI services) – no titles and no content.
abfluss.titel: Send the documents’ text to a service?
abfluss.text: “{paket}” may access the network. With this choice it sends the text of the documents someone fills in fields from to a service outside Ablago. If it runs in your own network, the data doesn’t leave the house; with another provider, you are trusting that provider.
typ.engine.netz: Package “{name}” – sends text over the network
typ.engine.hilfe: The built-in recognition finds email addresses, phone numbers, dates, amounts and the like using patterns. A package such as an AI assistant also recognises free text and difficult receipts.
ergebnis.gekuerzt: Document text shortened – the AI service only read the beginning, details further down may be missing.
